about: The collision audit's CI limits, islands mode (decision 148: the wild island without its hamlet, its own animals only: --wild-island kept; 5,328 animals, 4,267 measured), measured on ark-next (5cd8efff + the gate fixes, 2026-11-12). Islands mode is what goes live. Pass-throughs and fence crossings stay at 0; cliffs and overlaps at most today's, measured as in thresholds.json (overlaps mostly perched sleepers sharing tree crowns). 2026-11-12, decision 204: the push between touching animals eased between the shared clock's 4 s moments (it never jumps: the default view's turns from separation gone) and still bodies holding their place against walkers; the eased push lags its moment, so overlaps rose about 0.2 per cent (islands: 3,222,835 to 3,228,997) and cliffs moved with the nudged positions (1276 to 1267). 2026-11-12 on ark-next 4c7215c5 (decision 202's paces and beds): a walk's goal its body cannot stand at, a shade spot on a mountain's face raised over the walk grid's ground only by the slope, is not gone to (a tenkile had rested on ground rising 2.1 in 1 for most of an hour: today's cliffs 1,305), and a flight climbs or comes down steeply enough to clear a fence beside it (a masked owl took off through a garden's pickets); islands: cliffs 1,267 to 210, overlaps 3,228,997 to 3,156,185.
